input.brief: Junior software developer studying economic cybernetics in Bucharest; shows real work across software, design and data: an airline database schema, a coffee brand's shop and 3D scenes, an agent-based market simulation in NetLogo

direction.name: The quiet instrument
direction.idea: Radical understatement. Where every competitor shouts, this page almost whispers: a headline barely larger than body text, a narrow column, small exact demonstrations, and a great deal of untouched space. The restraint is the claim. It says the thing is simple, finished and sure of itself. This only works when it is carried through completely; one loud element breaks it. In the study, a tool for simple lists sold itself with a 27px headline and 12–14px copy and was one of the most confident pages in the set.
direction.composition: A single column 440–560px wide, placed left of centre (starting at about 22% of the viewport width) or dead centre, running the whole page. The headline is the one large thing on the first screen: two lines at display size (5–7vw), medium weight, starting on the column's left edge and allowed to run wider than the column. The supporting paragraph follows at body size (17–19px) in the full ink. One small primary button and one text link. Below, each point is a short paragraph followed by a compact demonstration or image no wider than the column. Sections are separated only by space (96–140px). Nothing spans the full width until the footer, which is a single quiet line. The first screen is mostly empty and that emptiness is composed: the column's top edge sits at about 30% of the viewport height.
direction.typography: One family, two weights. A display size for the headline (5–7vw), one heading size for section titles (about 32–40px), body at 17–19px, a small size for captions (14–15px). Leading 1.5 for text. Letter-spacing near zero. The typeface must be handsome at small sizes.
direction.colour: Paper and two inks (full and soft). One accent used on exactly one element per screen.
direction.imagery: Precise rather than loud: cropped interface details at true size, and real photographs of the customer's world held to the column width, each doing one job. One short looping clip can sit at column width too. Never a large stock hero image.
direction.richness: Precision. With so little on the page, alignment, spacing and the exact size relationships are the design. Every element shares the column's left edge.
direction.pitfalls: This is the one direction where a small headline is right; the inspector will not object, but do not mix it with a large display line. Emptiness must look decided: keep the column edges exact and the vertical rhythm even. Not suitable when the subject needs emotion or photography to sell. Quiet is not thin: the column must still deliver every piece of content the brief asks for, in full, at 16px or more in the full ink. In blind tests the quiet version lost every time it was quiet everywhere: a small headline beside an empty panel read as unfinished. Quiet means few things, not small things: the headline and the demonstration are large, and every screen holds content.

hero.name: Column on one line
hero.blueprint: A warm off-white page that is more than 80% empty. Everything hangs on one vertical alignment 27% in from the left edge, the start of column 4; nothing is centred and nothing sits to its left. A small logo mark sits on that alignment 56px from the top. About 220px lower the column begins, only 380px wide: a two-line headline at 27px in medium weight, line-height 1.25; one supporting sentence at 15px in the softer ink, line-height 1.5; then, 28px below, the single action as a near-black rectangular button with 4px corners and one text link with an arrow beside it. A sign-in text link sits alone in the top-right corner at 14px; there is no navigation bar. At the bottom edge the first demonstration peeks in on the same alignment: a flat panel one step darker than the page, 368px wide, its top 90px visible, holding two real rows of the product's interface at true size with a visible pointer. Mark the panel's root with data-ui. The right half of the screen is blank on purpose, and nothing spans the full width until the footer.
hero.mobile: The alignment becomes the 24px left margin. The logo mark sits 32px from the top and the column starts at 30% of the height: headline at 24px on two lines, the sentence at 15px, then button and text link side by side. The demonstration panel spans the width between the margins and shows its top 120px above the fold. The sign-in link stays top-right.
hero.headline: A dry two-line statement at 27px, up to about 30 characters per line; it never grows larger at any width.

motion.name: Slow crossfade
motion.description: The principal photograph quietly changes: three or four images of the same framing crossfade over about 1.6 seconds, holding five to six seconds each, or the fixed image changes when its matching section arrives. It should feel like light shifting in a room. Pause when the tab is hidden; under reduced motion show only the first image.

sections.name: Lead line over four columns
sections.blueprint: Two parts on one 12-column grid with 20px margins. First, a lead paragraph of 30–40 words spans all 12 columns at clamp(22px, 2.2vw, 32px), regular weight, leading 1.2: three lines that read as the opening of a text, with no heading before it. 72px below, four equal columns (three grid columns each, 24px gutters) carry small text at 14–15px with leading 1.45. Each column is one paragraph of 40–70 words that opens with a bold run-in phrase of two or three words in full ink, the rest continuing on the same line in the soft ink. Columns top-align and end ragged at different depths. No cards, icons or dividers; the bold run-ins are the only markers. The four columns answer four plain questions: who, what, where, how to reach them. Padding is modest, 96px top and bottom, so a sheet of images can start straight after.
sections.mobile: The lead paragraph at 20px, full width. The four columns become a two-by-two grid with a 20px gutter and 40px row gap at 14px; if any paragraph exceeds 60 words, switch to one column with 32px between paragraphs. Run-in phrases stay bold.

sections.name: Live demo with controls
sections.blueprint: One filled panel, 680–760px wide and about 640px tall, radius 12px, in a tone clearly darker or lighter than the ground, placed on the text column's left edge or centred, with at least 15vh of empty ground above and below. The panel is split 62/38 into two flat areas that differ by one tone. Left area: the product doing its job on real content at true size. Right area: a narrow column of working controls, six to nine stacked rows 44px tall, each with a name at 14px on the left and a slider, toggle or value on the right; changing one changes the demonstration at once. A text link sits in the panel's bottom-left corner. The heading, two to four words at 24–32px, sits above the panel on its left edge with one sentence at 16px; under the panel, one line of start instruction.
sections.mobile: The panel fills the width. The demonstration takes the top at 4:3; the controls follow beneath as full-width rows 52px tall, only the four most telling ones, with a text link that reveals the rest. Heading and sentence sit above at 24px and 16px.

sections.name: Quiet ledger, side preview
sections.blueprint: A plain ledger in one column 560px wide whose left edge sits at 22% of the viewport width. A heading of two or three words at 24–28px in medium weight, then 32px of space, then one row per project, 44px tall: the name at 16px in full ink at the left, the kind of work at 14px in the soft ink starting at 55% of the column, and the year right-aligned with tabular figures. Nothing is drawn between rows; the three fixed starts make the columns. Hovering or focusing a row keeps it in full ink, drops the others to the soft ink, and shows that project's image in the empty area right of the column: a 4:3 frame 300px wide, `position: absolute`, its top aligned to the hovered row, 64px from the column's right edge, appearing with a 150ms fade. Holds 6–20 rows; group by year with 28px of extra space.
sections.mobile: The column fills the width with 20px margins. Rows are 52px tall: name at the left, year at the right, kind of work on a second line at 13px. There is no hover preview; instead the first three projects each show a 16:10 image at full column width above their row.

sections.name: Founder's letter
sections.blueprint: A letter in a centred column 520px wide with at least 160px of empty ground above and below. At the column's top-left, a round portrait 44px across. 28px below it, four or five short paragraphs at 16–17px with leading 1.55, each two to four lines and separated by one blank line, written in the first person. No heading. The sign-off is the writer's name at 22px in the text face's italic, with the role at 14px in the soft ink beneath it. One phrase in the letter may carry a flat marker-colour background. Variant for a page built as an object: the letter sits on a filled paper-colour sheet 640px wide with 60px padding on a contrasting ground, square corners, its bottom edge cut into small scallops with `clip-path`, and below a row of 5px round dots a tear-off strip 72px tall that carries the email address.
sections.mobile: The column takes the full width with 24px margins; text at 16px, portrait 40px. In the sheet variant the sheet spans edge to edge with 24px padding and keeps its shaped bottom edge; the tear-off strip stacks the email above a full-width button.

sections.name: Sentence, portrait, two links
sections.blueprint: One closing row of three elements hanging from the same top line, with open ground between them, on a 12-column grid. Columns 1–5: a sentence of 12–18 words at clamp(26px, 3vw, 44px), four lines, leading 1.1, saying what kind of enquiries are welcome; it is set as a paragraph and there is no separate heading. Columns 8–9: one small square portrait or photograph of the place, 150–170px, with square corners. Columns 10–12: a short question at 18px in medium weight, then 20px below it two underlined links stacked at 18px (the email address and one booking or social link), and beneath them a line at 14px in the soft ink with the city and the usual reply time. Columns 6–7 stay empty. The row has 160px of space above and 120px below. No form. On a dark ground the photograph is the only bright thing in the row.
sections.mobile: The sentence comes first at 7.4vw. Below it the portrait at 96px square sits at the left margin with the question and the two links to its right, top-aligned, in the remaining width. The city and reply-time line spans the full width beneath.

sections.name: A single quiet line
sections.blueprint: No footer block at all. After at least 30svh of empty page ground, one baseline 30px above the bottom edge carries three items in the page's ordinary small text size (14–16px), the same size and weight as the navigation: at the left margin, what this is in three or four words; centred, two to five links separated by 24px of space; at the right margin, the year and a privacy link. Use a three-column grid (1fr auto 1fr) so the centre group is truly centred whatever the side lengths. No logo, no background change, no line above it, no columns. Links are in the full ink; the rest in the softer ink. If the page has a narrow text column, the three items may instead sit on that column's left edge as one wrapped line. The restraint only works if the page above has already made its invitation.
sections.mobile: Three short lines at 14px on the left margin with 8px between them: the description, the links on one wrapped line, then year and privacy. Links stay in the full ink. Leave 20svh of empty ground above and 24px below.

references.name: Plastic
references.idea: A plain, quiet app page given one physical object: a photographed vinyl record cropped by the top-right corner of the viewport.
references.hero: Pale grey page with no navigation, only a bold wordmark with a small orange-red caps descriptor beneath it at top left (80px margin). A photographed black vinyl record with an orange-red label is cropped by the top-right corner, showing a quarter disc about 360px wide and tall, with an orange wire stand poking out below it. The headline is centred slightly above the middle in two lines at 74px (5.2vw), about 37% of the viewport wide, followed by a two-line 17px sentence and two black store badges side by side. Lower down, an award mark and a laurel-framed rating sit centred; the bottom fifth is empty.
references.type: Archivo only. Headline weight 500, sentence case, tight leading, 74px against 17px body, about a 4.4x jump. Feature headings near 30px in two colours, a much larger heading in the dark section (digest peak 12vw), and tiny tracked caps in the footer.
references.colour: #f5f5f5 #d5d5d5 #090d0e #171615 #e0441c — Greys and near-black with one orange-red accent taken from the record label; it colours the logo descriptor and the first line of each feature heading. One near-black section breaks the light page.
references.imagery: Phone mockups with real app screens (album-cover grids, a camera view) sit inside mid-grey rounded panels and are cropped by the panel edge. The hero uses a cut-out photographed record with a soft shadow; album art supplies the colour.
references.layout: Centred hero, then feature rows on a wide container: a tall grey panel on one side and a short text block vertically centred on the other, sides swapping per row. A dark full-width section with offset white cards follows, then a narrow FAQ column and a sparse footer.

sections.description: Each feature is a two-column row. One column is a mid-grey rounded panel about 540px wide and 720px tall containing a phone mockup pinned near the top, with the next phone's top edge peeking in at the panel's bottom. The other column holds a two-line heading, first line orange-red and second near-black at the same size, over a three-line grey paragraph, vertically centred. The panel side alternates left and right.

A near-black full-width section opens with a large centred white heading. Below it, white rounded cards of different sizes are placed off-grid at staggered horizontal positions: one holds an album-cover collage with a record sliding out, with a bold white caption and a grey line beneath it on the dark ground; another is a small data card listing collection fields as label and value rows.

A left-aligned column about 480px wide, offset toward the page centre and headed by a bold short title. Six questions in small bold text are separated by hairlines, each with a plus sign at the right edge. A generous empty gap follows before a footer of three tiny caps link groups spread left, centre and right, small legal notes, and a pipe-separated caps link row.

steal: Crop one photographed physical object by a viewport corner so the hero has a subject without a centred mockup.
Set two-line feature headings at one size with the first line in the accent colour and the second in ink.
Drop the nav entirely on a one-page app site: wordmark plus a one-line descriptor top left, store badges directly under the headline.

references.name: Cursor Compile
references.idea: The event name drawn as seven looping one-line curves in seven colours, more signature than logotype, on an otherwise whisper-quiet off-white page whose images are re-rendered as rows of coloured characters.
references.hero: Warm off-white field with no header or navigation. Starting about 23% down, a line-drawn wordmark spans from 8% to 92% of the width and about 29% of the height: each letter is a single 2px stroke looping like a Lissajous figure, each in a different colour (orange, green, olive, lilac, black, brown, blue), overlapping its neighbours. Directly beneath, two 14px captions, one flush left in ink and one flush right in grey. After a gap of about 20% of the viewport, three equal columns sit at the bottom, each topped by a hairline: an 18px statement, a grey 14px paragraph, and an email field over a full-width near-black rectangular button.
references.type: The only large lettering is the drawn wordmark. All real text is CursorGothic regular in two sizes, 18px and 14px (the largest text on the page is 1.8vw), sentence case, with hierarchy made by ink versus mid-grey rather than by size or weight.
references.colour: #edece8 #26251e #f07a1f #2e9e3a #2f6bf0 #9b8ff0 — Warm paper ground with near-black and grey text. The wordmark's colours return one at a time as the single ink of each character-rendered image (lilac, teal, green, orange). Event photos are dark and warm.
references.imagery: Two kinds: landmarks and speaker portraits redrawn as rows of tiny characters in one saturated colour on a tint of the same colour; and dark, warm documentary event photos. All are square-cornered rectangles in strict rows.
references.layout: About 7% side margins on a three-column grid. Each section has a small two-line heading at left (title in ink, subtitle in grey), then a row or carousel of equal tiles with one-line captions beneath. Very large vertical gaps between sections; a denser photo grid near the end.

sections.description: Tour dates as a three-column grid of 3:2 tiles. Each tile is a city landmark rendered entirely in rows of small characters in one colour on a pale tint of that colour: lilac, teal, green, orange. Under each tile, one caption line: city name in ink, date in grey straight after it, and a status word flush right. A fourth tile wraps alone to the left of a second row, leaving two columns empty.

Session recordings as stacked carousels. A small heading and grey subtitle, then per stage a tiny label at left with two arrow glyphs at far right and a row of 16:9 dark photo tiles, two full tiles visible and a third cropped by the margin. Each tile has a small white event tag in its bottom-left corner. Caption beneath: speaker name in ink followed by the talk title in grey on the same line.

Speaker row: one-line heading at left, arrows at right, then four near-square portrait tiles with 8px gaps, each a face drawn in horizontal rows of characters in one colour on its tint (orange, green, lilac, teal). Some tiles show only plain stripes with the face barely emerging, so portraits appear to resolve from lines as they load or on hover.

After a three-column photo grid with mixed landscape and portrait crops and 8px gaps, the page ends on an empty off-white screen holding one centred sentence at 18px and a small dark pill button beneath it. There are no footer columns, links or legal rows.

steal: Draw the name as one continuous thin looping stroke per letter, each in a different colour, and let it be the only large element on the page.
Keep all text at two small sizes and build hierarchy from ink versus grey on the same line (name in ink, detail in grey right after it).
Re-render photographs as rows of tiny characters in a single saturated colour on a tint of that colour, one colour per tile.

references.name: Léo Parpeix - Portfolio 2026
references.idea: A soft clay-rendered 3D world, a smiling flower in a sunlit gallery and a bee you can feed, carries the designer's personality while the type stays blunt and heavy.
references.hero: Opens on an empty off-white field with one object: a nearly square card about 28% of the viewport wide, centred, with rounded corners and tilted in 3D perspective, showing a grainy beige render of a smiling clay flower in front of a gridded window. There is no text at all. The card then scales up and flattens into a full-bleed 3D gallery room (flower on a plinth, pale wood floor, sky through tall windows) with a one-line 14px nav laid over it: name far left, role about one-eighth across, three links and a dots menu far right.
references.type: One family (digest name 'text') does everything: 14px regular for nav, captions and metadata, about 24px for intro sentences, and a bold geometric uppercase at 6 to 11vw with leading near 0.9 for centred three-line statements. Almost nothing sits between caption size and display size.
references.colour: #f7f7f7 #0d2a1c #e3d9ca #babeb7 #f6e016 #000000 — Off-white ground with display type in a near-black bottle green rather than black. The 3D scenes are beige and sky blue; the bee's yellow is the only saturated note; one later section turns fully yellow.
references.imagery: Custom clay-like 3D renders with film grain (flower, plinths, bee) and case-study mock-ups of laptops shot on stone or steel. Project images are square-cornered and laid edge to edge in a horizontal strip, with neighbours cut off by the viewport.
references.layout: Alternates full-bleed 3D, centred giant type on blank off-white, and an editorial block where intro text starts past the midpoint and the left half stays empty. The project strip bleeds off both edges; metadata sits beneath in widely spaced small columns.

sections.description: Blank off-white screen with three centred lines of bold uppercase in bottle green, each about 6vw tall with tight leading, the block about 60% of the viewport wide. A small glossy 3D bee hovers over the first line, overlapping the letters, with a soft grey shadow blob cast onto the second line. A tiny parenthesised instruction at 10px sits centred under the block. Nothing else on screen.

Text begins around 55% across: a three-line sentence at about 24px, then two short paragraphs at 14px indented further right, with an asterisk hanging alone in the margin to their left. A white square card carrying a stacked two-line logo sits at the far right, top-aligned with the sentence. The whole left half of the screen stays empty.

Under a small sentence-case label, a horizontal strip of images spans the full viewport: one wide central image, about 73% of the width, flanked by narrow slivers of the previous and next slides cropped by the edges, with 10px gaps. Below, one row of 12 to 14px metadata: index number and client far left, year at centre, team and roles in a right-hand column, and an underlined project link lower left.

Full-screen off-white closing. Three centred lines of the same bold uppercase green type at about 11vw fill three-quarters of the width, with the bee and its detached shadow floating above the first line. A single line of tiny text runs along the bottom edge: credits left, three contact links separated by bullets at centre, copyright right.

steal: Start with one small tilted card on an empty page and scale it into the full-bleed hero scene, so loader and hero are the same object.
Set display type in a near-black green instead of black; it still reads as ink but ties the type to the imagery.
Let a small 3D mascot overlap giant flat type and cast a soft shadow onto it to give a purely typographic screen depth.
references.media: The hero is a real-time 3D interior seen through a rounded rhombus mask that starts as a 165px tip at the bottom of a blank fold and grows to cover the whole viewport by about 900px of scroll. Below: full-width project slider strips with neighbours peeking at both edges, a full-bleed 3D room as an interlude under a statement, a small 47s reel beside a left-aligned intro, and an archive index with hover previews; two fixed WebGL canvases, square-cornered frames, laptops staged on stone and steel.
references.motion: A blank screen, then a 14px loader line from 1.2s past 4.5s, ending on an empty fold with only the rhombus tip. Lenis with canvas-driven pinning: the rhombus grows and turns to full bleed over about 900-1800px, the 3D interlude holds over a 2616px runway while its statement lines brighten from about 20% to 100%, and display words swap between two three-line sets; the house ease is cubic-bezier(.16,1,.1,1), 43 uses, mostly at .75s and 1s.
